tooltip.ironmod.module.propulsion: Install on boots to enable flight.
tooltip.ironmod.module.repulsor: Install on chestplate. Shift + right-click (air) fires a repulsor blast.
tooltip.ironmod.module.projectile_call: Install on chestplate to allow calling the suit remotely.
tooltip.ironmod.module.nanotech: Nanoparticles: an energy shield that absorbs damage and slowly self-repairs the piece.
tooltip.ironmod.module.charged_beam: Install on chestplate. Use the Beam Emitter: hold to charge, release to fire.
tooltip.ironmod.module.fire_immunity: Install on chestplate. You never catch fire again.
tooltip.ironmod.module.projectile_immuni: Install on chestplate. Negates damage from arrows and projectiles.
tooltip.ironmod.module.water_breathing: Install on helmet. Breathe underwater indefinitely.
tooltip.ironmod.module.metal_skin: Install on leggings. Reduces knockback and immunizes against poison/wither.
tooltip.ironmod.module.shield: Install on chestplate. Energy shield that absorbs damage and recharges over time.
tooltip.ironmod.module.sentinel_mode: Install on chestplate. Double-tap Shift quickly to toggle Sentinel Mode (strength and resistance).
message.ironmod.no_chestplate: You need the suit chestplate in your inventory!
message.ironmod.no_call_module: The chestplate needs the Auto-Call Module!
message.ironmod.no_beam_module: The chestplate needs the Charged Beam Module!
